edges.rationale: Scikit-Learn is a popular Python-based machine learning library, and the JD explicitly states using it for model development.
TensorFlow is a widely used Python-based framework for building and training machine learning models. The JD mentions using it.
Keras is a high-level API that runs on top of TensorFlow and is commonly used with Python.
Hugging Face provides Python libraries for working with transformer models, which are frequently used in NLP tasks. The job context refers to using it for text representation.
Scikit-Learn can be used for analyzing medical datasets and implementing various machine learning algorithms. This is implied by the use case.
TensorFlow is a suitable framework for handling and training models on larger medical datasets.
Hugging Face provides tools for processing medical text data which aligns with the dataset type.
Python programming is a core skill and fundamental part of the IA/ML domain.
Effective communication and collaboration are essential for successful team projects, complementing professional expertise.
